repo:cloud#2 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BvBxgE3eHdj5Z3oEuG

os-dev-report · 2026-11-03T10:41Z · status **PR open** · PR #29911 (draft) · branch `claude/project-thread-29cp8d` · head `535bc1fb`

- **Cause, confirmed:** the comment-thread gate (plugin-audit) and the attachment gate (service-storage) OR one `ReadableIds` branch per registered parent object. `driver-sql` emitted every `$or` / `$and` as one flat chain, which SQLite parses into a tree as deep as the chain is long. Hosted libSQL refuses depth above 100. Local SQLite allows 1000, which is why a local stack answered 200.
- **Fix, in the driver and not in the gates:** a group of more than 8 members is emitted as balanced parenthesised halves (`sql-driver-balanced-group.ts`, used by both combinator arms of `applyFilterCondition`). The depth now grows with log N: about 11 levels for 130 branches instead of 130. A group of 8 or fewer compiles to the same SQL text as before. Turso and sqlite-wasm inherit the change. The gates' WHERE is unchanged, so rows, totals and withholding cannot drift. Narrowing on `thread_id` the way #24177 does was not taken, because an unfiltered or sorted read would still carry every branch.
- **Regression tests with a 100-level budget:** better-sqlite3 and sql.js expose no `sqlite3_limit`. Each test re-runs the driver's own statement with its WHERE under 900 `and 1` levels, so it fits under 1000 only when the WHERE fits under 100. The calibration is pinned before anything is measured.
  - Driver unit test: 7 cases. Before the fix 3 failed, after it all 7 pass.
  - Dogfood test with 130 extra parent objects, real SecurityPlugin, AuditPlugin, StorageServicePlugin and sql.js, using the card's three query strings at the HTTP door. Before the fix all 8 cases failed, and every read answered **500** under the budget. After the fix all 8 pass, with identical status, rows and total whether the budget is on or off. Rows on the writer's private case and on an unreadable object stay withheld.
- **Local runs:** driver-sql 3858 passed, driver-turso 2496, driver-sqlite-wasm 750, plugin-audit 1120, service-storage 1326, all with 0 failures. 63 of 66 derived gates passed. The other 3 are prerequisites of this container (shallow clone, no-DTS build, unbuilt packages) and are not findings. `driver-sql` typecheck is clean. After merging `main`, which touched the comment and attachment hooks, the scoped re-check is green: the new dogfood test plus the comment-pair and attachment scan-cap dogfood suites (17 passed), and the driver group and `$or` suites (45 passed).
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/driver-sql` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Noted, not changed:** `service-analytics` `read-scope-sql.ts` joins `$or` / `$and` the same flat way for analytics RLS scopes. It is not on the gated read path.
- **Claim:** this card carries no `Claim:` comment. The dispatch ORDER names this session's branch.
